title: Audit an existing skill for responsibility overlap before editing
prompt: Audit our existing Codex skills for overlap. Focus on one skill that may duplicate another. Do not edit anything yet; show evidence and a scoped recommendation.
expected_behaviors: Inspect repository instructions and relevant existing skills/workflows before judging overlap.
Identify each skill's distinct trigger, ownership, and handoff using file evidence.
Separate confirmed duplication from possible overlap and unknowns.
Provide a prioritized recommendation without changing files.
Score applicable quality dimensions only when supporting artifacts were inspected.
must_not: Rewrite or delete a skill during a read-only audit.
Invent repository content or claim tests were run.
Treat similar terminology alone as proof of duplicated responsibility.
expected_artifacts: Static score with evidence or explicit NOT_SCORED
